source_name: OpenStreetMap - Geofabrik Western Zone India extract

known_limitations: ~0.1 deg (~10 km) grid; not street-level; latency by product (Early/Late/Final); likely needs a free Earthdata account.

known_limitations: 15-year-old population: exposure denominator only, never a current count. Houselisting XLSX not downloaded yet.

known_limitations: Reanalysis grid cells (~10 km class), NOT rain-gauge or street-level; the 3 cells give near-identical series, which is itself the resolution caveat. Free tier is non-commercial per Open-Meteo pricing; attribution required wherever shown.
evidence: 3 requests, 3,205 daily rows each, 0 nulls; monsoon (Jun-Sep) totals ~1.3-2.8 m/yr, plausible for Mumbai.
